edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: Subclinical hypothyroidism has a biologically plausible route to worse all-cause mortality, and the mechanism is consistent with the kinds of tissues or systems most directly exposed.
edges.summary: The anchor for this edge is the 2024 Han meta analysis in Medicine (Baltimore), which suggests that subclinical hypothyroidism tracks with higher risk or worse outcomes for all-cause mortality. Later papers point in much the same direction, so the live uncertainty is usually about effect size or which subgroups carry the signal most strongly.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
